validationBehavior.description: When fields show built-in validation errors. With native, the browser checks each field's rules, such as required and type, when the form is submitted, and a failing field stops the submit. With aria, those rules show no error and stop no submit, so the application decides when a field is invalid.

validationErrors.description: Errors from the application or a server, keyed by field name, each one message or an array of messages. A field shows its errors at once, and editing it or resetting the form dismisses them until a new object arrives.

MuxUIValidationErrors.description: Messages for the fields of a Form, keyed by field name. Each value is one message or several.
